admission.justification: A rebuild that dropped the new fields would show frozen rows with invented revisions and lose authored effects; the pass-through keeps reads whole.

applicability: History index builds, rebuilds and public timeline and record reads
conditions: Rows with recorded effect and own revision
exclusions: Unreadable files and incomplete indexes, reported unavailable and never a measured absence

evidence: public-four-label-results.json: four labels x two real GETs, full row equality, two fresh indexes and reader-cache deletion/rebuild; fixture refs/history unchanged; earlier-attempt byte tests.

statement: The existing index and public reader retain the complete history row and its owner, path, row identity, closed flag and authored effect/revision after index rebuilding.
